crossRefs.note: The plans of the heart belong to man, but the answer of the tongue is from Yahweh.
There are many plans in a man’s heart, but Yahweh’s counsel will prevail.
A man’s steps are from Yahweh; how then can man understand his way?
There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against Yahweh.
A man’s steps are established by Yahweh. He delights in his way.
I declare the end from the beginning, and from ancient times things that are not yet done. I say: My counsel will…
Yahweh, I know that the way of man is not in himself. It is not in man who walks to direct his steps.

translations.web: A man’s heart plans his course, but Yahweh directs his steps.
translations.bsb: A man’s heart plans his course, but the LORD determines his steps.
translations.kjv: A man's heart deviseth his way: but the LORD directeth his steps.
translations.asv: A man's heart deviseth his way; But Jehovah directeth his steps.
